thread_title: S. alata dark interior Stone Co, MS
breadcrumb: S. alata dark interior Stone Co, MS

posts.body_html:
well, the interior isn't really dark yet, maybe the traps need to age a bit more before this one colors up. What is very surprising is the sheer height of one of the traps, probably 3+ feet tall! It's really hard to tell scale from the photo, but it's really dang tall!

This clone was originally selected because it's got a dark interior, and I think the trap can get very dark, but it hasn't really colored up for me in the past 2-3 years. Maybe this really needs just the right conditions to color up, I'm not sure. It seems height and size of the traps are now a more interesting characteristic of this vigorous clone! We'll see what happens, if anything, with the fall traps.
